summary: AEVEX Corp. filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026 announcing completion of its acquisition of Maritime Applied Physics, LLC (d/b/a/formerly Maritime Applied Physics Corporation) from Black Sea Technologies, LLC for a total enterprise value of $600 million, subject to customary adjustments. Consideration consisted of 12,727,273 Class A shares valued at $350 million plus cash for the balance, with a $5 million working-capital adjustment escrow and up to $50 million in earnout contingent on AVEX trading at or above $28.00 and the target achieving specified GARC/CHASER revenue and gross profit targets through December 31, 2027. No advisor or board recommendation was named in the excerpt.
